name: Model-driven sports taking (pre-game and hold-to-settlement)
one_line: Own fair probability from ratings and devigged sharp lines; buy the underpriced side by more than the 0.05 fee, fractional Kelly, hold to settlement; the style of the three largest sports wallets, taxed since July 2026.
maturity: Established; leaders rotate (swisstony silent since 26 Aug, kch123 since 29 Jun, RN1 active); post-July fee leaves HF takers 0.35-1.1% of volume; 'model-driven' inferred from behaviour
requires_ai: no; optional LLM for injury/lineup text and title mapping
edge: Sharp-anchored book pushed by public money; no sports FLB; sharps unbannable here
capital: $10k+ to matter ($1k-$10k to learn); variance not lock-up binds
build_time: 3-6 weeks plumbing if a model exists; model is multi-season
opportunity_size: Sports ~$100M/day; Sep leaderboard #1 $3.65M, #10 $1.0M; edge/dollar shrinking after fee rise
expected_results: RN1 +$0.8-2.1M/month realised in 2026 (1.8% of volume); HF takers 0.35-1.1% net; solo guess +4-18%/quarter with a validated 2-3 pt edge, 30-41% losing quarters
competition: industrial buy-only accounts, new big soccer whales, salaried desks
flag: none (own model, non-US); grey if selling picks (CTA)
validate: 6-week CLV log vs devigged Pinnacle and paper buys; pass CLV > +1.5c after fee, t > 2, 300+ bets
top_risk: Fee 2.5-4% of outlay plus variance without a real edge
solo_fit_reason: Hard data proves the style pays and data is free, but the edge is a sports model that takes seasons to build and validate; after the 0.05 fee only a CLV-positive model survives, and returns are lumpy (30-40% losing quarters at quarter-Kelly).
speed_class: execution-sensitive: model edge, 1 s sports delay, news repricing
changes_made: Split from the feed-latency variant per the critic; only modelling and hold-to-settlement covered.
